focal_run.library_pool_note: NCBI design states unenriched libraries were mixed with target-enriched libraries at 3:2.

interpretation.primary: The public C. sieboldii library is not grossly incompatible with the original generic Compositae1061 nucleotide target: reads reach 1033/1061 target loci, and 1006/1061 loci have at least 10 mapped reads in this direct-mapping smoke.
interpretation.augmentation_upper_bound: At an any-hit definition, only 28/1061 loci can be newly rescued by target-file augmentation, so the maximum possible gross locus-recovery gain is 2.64 percentage points. This does not bound improvements in assembly quality, allelic balance, paralog resolution, or sequence identity.
interpretation.mapping_fraction_boundary: The 24.37% read mapping fraction should not be interpreted as low capture efficiency because the public design explicitly mixed unenriched and target-enriched libraries at a 3:2 ratio.
interpretation.decision_ceiling: This is a technical smoke pass only. It does not authorize PUBLIC_TRANSFER_GREEN, local ancestry, haplotype age, recombination blocks, structural-variant reuse, module-specific local genealogy, or genotype-phenotype association.
